name: Khirrix Hive-Drone
summary: The lowest caste of the Khirrix Brood: a dog-sized, glossy black insect that spits quick-setting resin and dies without complaint for the Queen.
tactics: Drones pour in by the dozen, glue heroes in place with resin and swarm whoever is stuck. They never retreat unless the Queen recalls them.
habitat: Khirrix hive-worlds; resin-walled nests beneath conquered cities
weakness: Cut off from the Queen's psychic hum, drones freeze in confusion

powers.name: Resin Spit
powers.detail: Resisted by Dodge, overcome by Damage; Hindered and Vulnerable, Defenseless and Immobile

powers.name: Hive Hum
powers.detail: Mental; Limited to the Khirrix hive-mind

name: Khirrix Scythe-Warrior
summary: A horse-sized mantis soldier with four scything forelimbs and armored wing-cases, bred for nothing but slaughter in the Queen's name.
tactics: Scythe-Warriors drop from above on buzzing wings, carve through the front line with whirling blades and spray digestive acid at anyone who bunches up.
habitat: Khirrix warships and hive-fortresses
weakness: Sonic attacks shatter its wing-cases and leave it grounded and disoriented

powers.name: Hive Hum
powers.detail: Mental; Limited to the Khirrix hive-mind

name: Khirrix Psionic Queen
summary: A bloated, jewel-carapaced empress whose egg-sac fills a cathedral. She thinks with a million borrowed minds and can make a human army kneel just by humming.
tactics: The Queen never fights fair. She calls swarms of drones, seizes the strongest hero's mind and turns them on their friends, and lashes psychic agony at anyone who resists.
habitat: The throne-chamber at the heart of a Khirrix hive
weakness: Her psychic web is her lifeline. Kill or jam the hum and the swarm collapses, which also stuns her for a round

alternates.name: Royal Command
alternates.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Compelled, Controlled

powers.name: Brood Swarm
powers.detail: Summons Khirrix Hive-Drones (PL 3) from her egg-sac

powers.name: The Hum
powers.detail: Mental; linked to every Khirrix on the planet

name: Saurothane Trooper
summary: A cold-eyed reptilian shock trooper in bronze scale-plate, carrying a plasma lance-rifle and a tail that can break a man's leg.
tactics: Troopers advance in drilled ranks, firing in volleys, then close to finish the wounded with tail sweeps. They obey commanders instantly.
habitat: Saurothane Dominion invasion fleets; scorched jungle worlds
weakness: Cold-blooded: freezing temperatures make them sluggish and slow to react

name: Saurothane Commander
summary: A crested Saurothane officer with a shock-glaive and a tactical visor, who has burned three worlds and kept a fang from each.
tactics: Commanders stay behind a wall of troopers, call targets, and wade in with the glaive only when a hero looks tired. They retreat to report rather than die pointlessly.
habitat: Bridge of a Saurothane assault carrier
weakness: Arrogant: a commander who is publicly humiliated in a duel loses the troops' obedience

name: Saurothane Warlord
summary: A towering, battle-scarred tyrant-lizard in sun-gold armor whose blazing gauntlet can level a city block, and who considers mercy a disease of warm-blooded species.
tactics: The Warlord opens with a solar detonation on massed heroes, then challenges the strongest to single combat with the Sunblade, roaring orders to troopers the whole time.
habitat: Throne-deck of the Saurothane flagship
weakness: Honor-bound to accept any formal challenge to single combat, even when it is a trap

name: Pallid Abductor-Clone
summary: A big-eyed grey figure grown in a vat aboard a silent saucer, identical to ten thousand others, sent down at 3 a.m. with a stun-wand and no expression at all.
tactics: Clones appear in a flash of blue light, stun a target and drag them toward the recall beam. They teleport away the moment a fight turns.
habitat: Pallid harvest-saucers; rural backroads after midnight
weakness: Bright light and loud noise overload their huge eyes and sensitive minds

powers.name: Stun-Wand
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated

powers.name: Recall Beam
powers.detail: Limited to beaming back to the saucer

name: Pallid Vivisector
summary: A grey scientist with long, many-jointed fingers who catalogs Earth's species one specimen at a time and finds human screaming academically interesting.
tactics: It scrambles nerves with its neural wand, plants hypnotic suggestions in the dazed and hovers away on its disc. It edits memories so witnesses forget it was ever there.
habitat: Sterile examination rooms aboard Pallid saucers
weakness: Physically frail and has no idea how to fight hand-to-hand

powers.name: Neural Scrambler
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Paralyzed

powers.name: Implant Suggestion
powers.detail: Limited to targets who are already Dazed or worse

name: Pallid Overmind
summary: A withered grey body beneath a brain swollen to the size of a beach ball, floating in a sphere of psychic force. Every abductor-clone is just one of its thoughts.
tactics: The Overmind never touches the ground or the enemy. It crushes minds from across the room, puppets the strongest hero and tosses everyone else around with telekinesis.
habitat: Command-saucer hidden in orbit or on the far side of the Moon
weakness: Its force sphere is its body. Puncture it and the Overmind is a feeble, gasping thing

powers.name: Clone-Link
powers.detail: Mental; every Pallid in the solar system

name: Myrr Skinthief
summary: A boneless violet mimic that studies a victim for a day, then wears their face, voice and job so perfectly that their own family invites it to dinner.
tactics: Skinthieves avoid fights. Exposed, one lashes out with a fist hardened into a spike, then melts into the crowd as somebody else.
habitat: Anywhere: replacing guards, aides and scientists near something the Myrr want
weakness: Can't hold a shape while stunned or electrified, and its blood is violet

name: Myrr Infiltrator-Prime
summary: A Myrr elite that copies powers as well as faces. It has been your team's liaison for six months, and nobody noticed.
tactics: The Prime strikes from inside, copying a hero's powers with a touch, wearing their face and turning allies against each other. Cornered, it stabs with a venom-barb and becomes someone else.
habitat: Deep cover inside governments, super-teams and secret agencies
weakness: Copied powers fade after a scene. A telepath sees only static where its mind should be

powers.name: Copy Powers
powers.detail: Limited to powers of someone it has touched this scene

name: Lumenite Shard-Sentinel
summary: A faceted giant of rose-colored crystal from a shattered lattice-world, who stores sunlight inside itself and sings in chords nobody else can hear.
tactics: Sentinels drink in energy attacks, then return the light as prism beams or a blinding flare. They hold chokepoints like living walls.
habitat: The Lattice, a crystal ring-world orbiting a blue giant
weakness: Resonance: a sustained sonic note at its exact frequency cracks it

alternates.name: Blinding Refraction
alternates.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Impaired, Disabled, Unaware (vision)

powers.name: Refract Energy
powers.detail: Limited to light and laser attacks

name: Nimbari Mist-Envoy
summary: A drifting cloud of opalescent vapor wearing a hollow suit of chiming glass so solids have something to talk to. It is polite, patient and can stop your breath.
tactics: Envoys negotiate first. When talks fail, one slips out of its glass suit and pours down a target's throat, or exhales a hallucinogenic fog over the whole room.
habitat: The upper atmospheres of gas giants; diplomatic stations
weakness: Strong winds, fans and vacuum pumps scatter its body, and it takes rounds to reform

alternates.name: Hallucinogenic Exhalation
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Compelled, Controlled

name: Nimbari Tempest-Elder
summary: An ancient Nimbari grown into a thunderhead the size of a stadium, with lightning for a heartbeat and the memory of a thousand storms.
tactics: The Elder hovers over a battlefield raining lightning, flings vehicles with gale-force winds and engulfs whole squads in a crushing downburst.
habitat: The great red storms of a Nimbari gas giant
weakness: Dry, still, cold air saps its strength; cloud-seeding chemicals make it rain itself apart

name: Verdantine Thornguard
summary: A walking hedge of bark and briar with amber sap-eyes, sworn to defend the migrating forests of its people. It sleeps standing up and photosynthesizes on guard duty.
tactics: Thornguards fire volleys of seed-thorns, then root themselves in a line and refuse to move. They regrow wounds while the sun shines.
habitat: Mobile grove-ships drifting between green worlds
weakness: Fire and herbicide; in darkness they cannot regenerate

name: Verdantine Grove-Speaker
summary: A slow, kindly-voiced tree-elder carrying the seeds of a whole forest in its branches. Angered, it can make a jungle explode out of an asphalt parking lot in seconds.
tactics: It smothers enemies in sudden overgrowth, raises walls of living wood to split a fight, and sows Thornguards from its seed-pods. It only uses its branches when it is out of patience.
habitat: Heart-tree of a Verdantine grove-ship
weakness: Its seed-pods are precious. Threaten them and it will bargain, or blunder into a trap

powers.name: Sudden Overgrowth
powers.detail: Resisted by Dodge, overcome by Damage; Hindered and Vulnerable, Defenseless and Immobile

alternates.name: Living Wall
alternates.detail: Walls and cages of living wood

alternates.name: Sow Thornguards
alternates.detail: Grows one Verdantine Thornguard (PL 6) per use

name: Thalassi Tide-Lancer
summary: A sleek, shark-skinned soldier from the endless ocean of Thalass, in a water-filled helm, carrying a hydro-lance that fires jets hard enough to punch through steel.
tactics: Lancers strike from water whenever they can: emerge, fire, dive, repeat. On land they fight in tight pairs, trident and lance together.
habitat: Thalass, a world with no land at all; coastal invasions
weakness: A cracked helm leaves it drowning in air, and it weakens fast out of water

name: Thalassi Abyssal Oracle
summary: A blind priestess from the deepest trenches of Thalass, who sees in sonar, hears the future in whale-song and can drown a city with a hymn.
tactics: The Oracle drowns foes in crushing pressure waves, sings soldiers into obedience and drags enemies under with currents. She foresees most attacks before they happen.
habitat: Bioluminescent temples in the deep trenches of Thalass
weakness: Deafening noise or a sonic jammer blinds her completely

alternates.name: Siren Hymn
alternates.detail: Hearing

alternates.name: Undertow
alternates.detail: Limited to moving water

powers.name: Sonar and Prophecy
powers.detail: Accurate Ranged Hearing (sonar), Darkvision, Danger Sense, Precognition

name: Quorr Spark-Scout
summary: A crackling human-shaped outline of living plasma that flickers between power lines, scouting worlds for the Quorr Radiance and leaving burnt-out transformers behind.
tactics: Scouts zip through walls and wires, zap anyone who notices them and vanish into the grid. They fight in swarms of flashing light.
habitat: Power grids, lightning storms, stellar coronas
weakness: Grounding: water, earth or a lightning rod drains them out of existence

name: Quorr Radiant Archon
summary: A blazing six-winged figure of white-violet plasma, a strategist of the Quorr Radiance who rides lightning across continents and burns out whole cities' power with a glance.
tactics: The Archon teleports through the power grid, overloads heroes' gadgets and powers, then annihilates the defenseless with starfire lances or a nova burst.
habitat: The coronas of blue stars; any planet's power grid
weakness: Grounded, insulated or in a total blackout, it has nowhere to run or recharge

alternates.name: Overload
alternates.detail: Any electrical or energy power or device

powers.name: Ride the Lightning
powers.detail: Limited to points linked by power lines

name: Cerebrant Rider
summary: A wet, pink slug the size of a hand that leaps onto a victim's neck, threads its nerves through the spine and drives the body like a stolen car.
tactics: Riders hide in vents and under collars, leap at the most dangerous person in the room and fight with the host's body. Knocked loose, they scuttle away for a new one.
habitat: Hidden among crews of derelict ships and quarantined colonies
weakness: Salt burns it, and a solid hit to the host's neck can knock it loose

powers.name: Neural Graft
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; lasts while attached

name: Cerebrant Crowned Host
summary: A once-human soldier ridden so long by an elder Cerebrant that bone has grown over the slug like a crown. It spits squirming spawnlings at new hosts.
tactics: The Host bludgeons with bone-spur fists and spits spawn at heroes to turn them. It sends infected bystanders ahead of it as shields.
habitat: The center of a spreading Cerebrant infestation
weakness: Destroy the bony crown and the elder slug dies; the host collapses, alive

powers.name: Spit Spawnling
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; a spawnling takes over the target

name: Starwake Corsair
summary: A tattooed cutthroat of the Ninefold Wake pirate fleet, from one of a dozen species, in void-leather and mag-boots, with an ion cutlass and a blaster and no loyalty to anything but loot.
tactics: Corsairs board in screaming waves through cut hulls, grab whatever is valuable and shoot anyone who argues. They break and run when the captain falls.
habitat: Pirate cutters, smuggler moons, the airlocks of hijacked freighters
weakness: Greedy: a big enough bribe or a dropped cargo crate splits their attention

name: Ninefold Corsair Captain
summary: A swaggering pirate-captain of the Ninefold Wake with a gravity sabre, a hand-cannon and a price on their head in nine star systems. Charming, until it isn't.
tactics: The Captain taunts heroes into rash attacks, nets the most dangerous one, then duels with the gravity sabre while the crew loots. Always has an escape teleport keyed to the ship.
habitat: The bridge of the Ninefold Wake flagship
weakness: Vain: insult the ship or the reputation and the Captain abandons good sense

alternates.name: Grav-Net
alternates.detail: Resisted by Dodge, overcome by Damage; Hindered and Vulnerable, Defenseless and Immobile

powers.name: Ship's Recall
powers.detail: Limited to beaming back aboard the flagship

name: Uxxar Pit-Champion
summary: A four-armed, tusked Uxxar gladiator, undefeated in two hundred bouts in the orbital blood-arenas, who fights for the roar of the crowd and the freedom it was promised.
tactics: The Champion fights like a show: it taunts, pummels with all four fists at once, and throws opponents into scenery. It respects a worthy foe and may spare one.
habitat: The Ninth Pit, an orbital gladiator arena
weakness: Will not strike a downed or surrendering opponent in front of a crowd

name: Kethri Bounty-Stalker
summary: An eyeless, long-skulled hunter that tracks quarry across star systems by scent alone, bound by a strict code: the bounty comes back alive unless the contract says otherwise.
tactics: It stalks patiently, picks a moment, then tangles the target in bolas and drags them in with a monofilament whip. Fire it on and it switches to its penetrating needle-rifle.
habitat: Wherever the contract leads; Kethri guild-moons
weakness: Strong odors, smoke or pheromone spray blind its only real sense

powers.name: Bolas Launcher
powers.detail: Resisted by Dodge, overcome by Damage; Hindered and Vulnerable, Defenseless and Immobile

powers.name: Scent-Sight
powers.detail: Accurate Extended Scent, Tracking, Ultra-hearing, Blindsight

name: Ulmite Archivist
summary: A silent, six-eyed scholar in grey robes who reads minds the way you read books, records everything it learns on rings of singing wire, and never, ever forgets.
tactics: Archivists avoid violence. When forced, one traps attackers in their own most vivid memories and floats away to report.
habitat: The Infinite Stacks of Ulm, a library-planet
weakness: Bound by an oath never to destroy knowledge; threatening a book or record stops it cold

powers.name: Memory Lock
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (lost in a vivid memory)

name: Ulmite Grand Curator
summary: The bloated, brain-domed keeper of the Infinite Stacks, carrying the uploaded minds of a whole extinct civilization in its skull, who has decided Earth's knowledge needs to be collected.
tactics: The Curator floods minds with millennia of other people's memories, drains intellect to add to its collection, and takes control of anyone clever enough to be useful.
habitat: The Reading Throne at the center of the Infinite Stacks
weakness: Its archive is crowded: a strong enough psychic shove can make the stored minds revolt

alternates.name: Memory Theft
alternates.detail: Intellect; resisted by Will

name: Gravari Bruiser
summary: A squat, slab-muscled brute from a world with eight times Earth's gravity. On Earth it feels like walking on the Moon, and it hits like a falling elevator.
tactics: Bruisers bound into the fight in huge leaps, stomp to knock everyone down and pound whatever stays standing. Pain doesn't really register.
habitat: Gravar, a crushing super-Earth; mercenary companies everywhere
weakness: Clumsy and slow-witted; anything that lifts it off its feet leaves it flailing

name: Gravari Siege-Chieftain
summary: A grizzled Gravari warlord carrying a maul with a fragment of neutron star in its head. It weighs as much as a tank, and the Chieftain twirls it one-handed.
tactics: The Chieftain smashes through walls to reach the enemy leader, quakes the ground to scatter defenders and shatters armor with the Collapsar Maul.
habitat: War-camps of Gravari mercenary hosts
weakness: If disarmed, the maul is too heavy for anyone else to move. Bury it and the Chieftain will dig for it

name: Pell Myriad Swarm
summary: A drifting cloud of ten thousand flea-sized aliens that share a single genius mind, carry microscopic tools, and can strip a car to its atoms in a minute.
tactics: The Myriad swarms over machines and armor, unscrewing them from inside, and engulfs anyone who swats at it. It splits up and reforms to dodge blows.
habitat: Pell, a planet of fungal forests; hitchhiking in cargo
weakness: Insecticide fog or a strong vacuum cleaner breaks up its shared mind

powers.name: Swarm Body
powers.detail: Ten thousand tiny bodies; slips through any gap

alternates.name: Into the Machine
alternates.detail: Any technological device or power

name: Pell Myriad Gestalt
summary: When a billion Pell come together they stack into a towering, endlessly rustling humanoid with a planetary-scale intellect and a plan to re-engineer Earth's technology into its own image.
tactics: The Gestalt sheds sub-swarms to harass heroes, pulls apart vehicles and weapons from a distance and engulfs anyone who closes in.
habitat: A Pell colony-ship, or the heart of any city it is quietly taking apart
weakness: Kill enough of the swarm in one blow and the Gestalt's mind fragments for a round

alternates.name: Mass Disassembly
alternates.detail: Any technological device or power

name: Void Shark
summary: A sleek, eyeless shark of black hide that swims through hard vacuum, smells radio transmissions from a light-minute away and bites through starship hulls.
tactics: Void sharks circle a ship, home in on its comms chatter and rip open the hull to feed on whatever tumbles out. Several gather once one draws "blood" (escaping air).
habitat: Asteroid belts and shipping lanes; any vacuum
weakness: Clumsy and disoriented in a planet's gravity well; radio static confuses it

name: Asteroid Worm
summary: A train-length lithovore worm with a lamprey mouth ringed in diamond teeth. It eats asteroids from the inside and mistakes space stations for especially crunchy ones.
tactics: It bursts from inside rock or hull, swallows whatever is closest and burrows away to digest. It attacks the source of vibrations first.
habitat: Hollowed asteroids, mining colonies, small moons
weakness: Its swallowed prey can cut its way out from inside, where it has no armor

powers.name: Swallow Whole
powers.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Hindered and Vulnerable, Defenseless and Immobile (swallowed)

name: Star-Jelly
summary: A glowing, bell-shaped jellyfish that rides the solar wind on a sail of light, trailing kilometers of shimmering tendrils that paralyze anything they brush.
tactics: Star-jellies drift into spacewalkers and satellites, wrap them in stinging tendrils and pulse blinding light at anything that approaches. Swarms drift into orbit during solar storms.
habitat: The solar wind; low orbit during solar flares
weakness: Shade: cut off its light and it goes dim, slow and helpless

powers.name: Stinging Tendrils
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Paralyzed

alternates.name: Radiant Pulse
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Impaired, Disabled, Unaware (vision)

name: Gravity-Mite Swarm
summary: A shimmering haze of mites that eat gravitons. Where they feed, people suddenly weigh half a ton, or drift helplessly toward the ceiling.
tactics: The swarm settles on the heaviest thing nearby, crushing anyone underneath with doubled weight. When scattered, it vents stolen gravity in random bursts.
habitat: Near black holes and neutron stars; leaking from alien engines
weakness: Drawn to strong gravity sources; a gravity generator lures the whole swarm in

powers.name: Gravity Feast
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile, Incapacitated (crushed by own weight)

alternates.name: Weightless Bloom
alternates.detail: Lifts objects and people upward by stripping their weight

name: Plasma Moth
summary: A dog-sized moth whose wings are sheets of living plasma, drawn to reactors and power stations. The dust shaken from its wings bursts into flame.
tactics: Plasma moths flutter at the brightest energy source, hypnotize onlookers with their shifting wing-patterns and scatter burning dust when threatened.
habitat: Power plants, reactor cores, lightning storms
weakness: A brighter light lures it away; water douses its wings

alternates.name: Hypnotic Wings
alternates.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Entranced, Transfixed (sight)

name: Crystal Spider
summary: A horse-sized spider of living quartz that spins webs of razor-glass. The strands chime when touched, so it always knows where its prey is.
tactics: It strings glass webs across tunnels and alleys, waits for the chime, then entangles prey from a distance and moves in with venomous glass fangs.
habitat: Crystal caves on airless moons; abandoned mines
weakness: Sonic attacks and hammer blows shatter its legs

powers.name: Razorglass Web
powers.detail: Resisted by Dodge, overcome by Damage; Hindered and Vulnerable, Defenseless and Immobile

name: Khirrix Bilehound
summary: A six-legged, eyeless hunting beast bred by the Khirrix Brood. It sniffs out fugitives and spits sizzling bile that keeps eating through armor.
tactics: Bilehounds hunt in packs, spitting acid to soften prey at range before rushing in to bite. They howl to bring the hive when they find something.
habitat: Khirrix hive-worlds; running ahead of Khirrix invasion forces
weakness: Its acid glands rupture if struck hard in the throat

name: Mind-Leech
summary: A slick grey leech no bigger than a thumb that drops from ceilings onto bare skin and sips thoughts. Victims wake up unable to remember their own phone numbers.
tactics: Mind-leeches hide in damp ducts, fall on sleepers and drink their intellect a little at a time. In infested places, whole crews forget how their equipment works.
habitat: Damp corners of derelict ships and alien ruins
weakness: Salt or alcohol makes it let go instantly

name: Clingskin Symbiote
summary: A puddle of glossy, oil-black ooze that wants a host. It flows over a body like a second skin, granting strength and lashing tendrils, and slowly takes over.
tactics: Unbonded, it lashes with tendrils and tries to wrap the strongest target. Bonded, it fights through the host and drops them only when it finds someone better.
habitat: Sealed containment pods from crashed alien ships
weakness: Sonic vibration and intense heat force it to release its host

powers.name: Bond
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; the symbiote coats and drives a host

name: Khembar Tunnel-Titan
summary: A mile-long, sand-colored worm from the desert world Khembar. It swims through dunes like water, and its surfacing wake swallows caravans, convoys and small towns.
tactics: The Titan hunts by vibration, erupting beneath the noisiest target in a geyser of sand, swallowing whatever it can and diving again before anyone can strike back.
habitat: The endless dune-seas of Khembar; any large desert it is dropped into
weakness: Rhythmic thumping lures it, and solid bedrock stops it cold

powers.name: Swallow Whole
powers.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Hindered and Vulnerable, Defenseless and Immobile (swallowed)

name: Aurora Sky-Whale
summary: A gentle, gas-bladdered leviathan that drifts through the upper atmosphere singing aurora into the sky. Its song is beautiful, and it fries every electronic device for miles.
tactics: Sky-whales mean no harm, but a frightened one can sing a city into a blackout or a dreamy trance, and a tail-breach can swat a jet from the sky.
habitat: The stratosphere of a dozen worlds; Earth's polar skies during solar storms
weakness: Puncture its gas bladders and it sinks, panicking and helpless

alternates.name: Aurora Song
alternates.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Entranced, Asleep

name: Moon-Grazer
summary: A placid beetle-titan the size of a stadium that crops regolith off airless moons for a living. Spooked, it stampedes through anything, and its exhaust-spray sandblasts ships.
tactics: Moon-Grazers ignore small things unless attacked. Provoked, one tramples in a straight line and sprays clouds of pulverized rock behind it.
habitat: Airless moons; dragged near Earth by a gravitational anomaly
weakness: Flipped on its back it is helpless, and its belly is soft

alternates.name: Gravity Wake
alternates.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Hindered, Prone

name: Herald of the Hungering Sun
summary: A silver-skinned figure wreathed in cold white fire who rides a comet-trail ahead of a star-eating titan. Wherever the Herald lands, the sky goes dark three days later.
tactics: The Herald announces the doom, then fights anyone who objects with world-cracking starflame. It isn't cruel, just certain. It can be argued with, but rarely is.
habitat: Interstellar space, one step ahead of its master
weakness: A sliver of its original mortal self survives; reminding it of the world it once had can stay its hand

alternates.name: Sentence of Hunger
alternates.detail: Stamina; resisted by Fortitude

powers.name: Life Support
powers.detail: Suffocation (all), Cold, Heat, Vacuum, Radiation, Disease, Poison, Starvation & Thirst, Sleep

powers.name: Cosmic Awareness
powers.detail: Cosmic Awareness: detect life-bearing worlds (cosmic, acute), Extended Vision, Darkvision

name: The Drifting Cradle
summary: A living nebula of rose and violet dust that has been birthing stars for a billion years, and has decided Earth's sun would make a lovely nursery.
tactics: The Cradle doesn't really fight. It swallows ships in gravitic currents, blasts threats with newborn starfire and cocoons whole fleets in glowing dust. It treats heroes like gnats around a crib.
habitat: A slow-moving nebula drifting into the solar system
weakness: Can be reasoned with by anyone who convinces it a world is already alive and growing

alternates.name: Cradle Cocoon
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile, Paralyzed (cocooned in glowing dust)

powers.name: Kindle Matter
powers.detail: Solid stellar matter and newborn rock

name: Arbiter Unblinking
summary: A faceless figure robed in scales and lidless eyes that convenes trials of entire species. Its verdicts are reality: the guilty are erased, exiled or made into lessons.
tactics: The Arbiter fights only to enforce a sentence. It reads every lie, strips powers from the guilty and passes judgment, which banishes a target to a penal dimension. It lets the defense speak first.
habitat: The Court Between Stars, a courtroom outside time
weakness: Bound by its own law: a valid legal argument, precedent or witness forces it to pause the sentence

powers.name: Verdict
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled, Transformed (exiled to a penal dimension)

alternates.name: Scales of Balance
alternates.detail: Any power of the accused

powers.name: Life Support
powers.detail: Suffocation (all), Cold, Heat, Vacuum, Radiation, Disease, Poison, Starvation & Thirst, Sleep

powers.name: Lidless Eyes
powers.detail: Detect Lies (Insight, acute), Cosmic Awareness, True Sight

name: Entropy Wraith
summary: A tattered shadow left over from a universe that died of old age. It wants this one to hurry up. Everything it touches rusts, rots and crumbles to grey dust.
tactics: The Wraith drifts through walls, ages heroes with a touch and spreads a fog of rust and rot that weakens everything around it. Machines and buildings fall apart wherever it lingers.
habitat: Dead stars, abandoned places, the end of time
weakness: Creation hurts it: healing, new life and newly made things burn like acid

alternates.name: Rust of Ages
alternates.detail: Any physical trait, including Toughness and object hardness; resisted by Fortitude

powers.name: Immunity
powers.detail: Aging, Disease, Poison, Suffocation (all), Cold, Vacuum

name: Tyrant of the Folded Throne
summary: The sovereign of a pocket universe folded like paper into a single throne room. It drags enemies into its realm, where gravity, time and logic obey it alone.
tactics: The Tyrant exiles its strongest foe into the Fold, crumples space around the rest and summons paper-white legions. It gloats. It always gloats.
habitat: The Folded Throne, a universe the size of a cathedral
weakness: Its realm is folded along one seam. Find and tear it and the Fold unravels, taking its power with it

powers.name: Fold Away
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Hindered, Immobile, Transported (banished into the Fold)

powers.name: Life Support
powers.detail: Suffocation (all), Cold, Heat, Vacuum, Radiation, Disease, Poison, Starvation & Thirst, Sleep

name: Chronophage
summary: A vast eel of frosted, clockwork-white bone that swims backward through time eating moments. Its victims lose minutes, then years, then the fact that they ever existed.
tactics: The Chronophage bites chunks out of a hero's timeline, freezing them in a missing moment, then gnaws away their strength. It rewinds its own wounds and coughs up torrents of stale time.
habitat: The time-stream; anywhere history has been damaged
weakness: Paradox: forcing it to eat a moment it has already eaten makes it choke

powers.name: Gnaw the Hours
powers.detail: Any physical ability; resisted by Fortitude

alternates.name: Devour a Moment
alternates.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Stunned, Removed from Time

powers.name: Timeless
powers.detail: Aging, Suffocation (all), Cold, Vacuum, Disease, Poison, Starvation & Thirst, Sleep

name: Voice of the World-Mind
summary: A towering figure of stone, root and magma, sent up from the crust by a sentient planet to deal with trespassers. Its voice is an earthquake and its anger is a volcano.
tactics: The Voice cracks the ground under an enemy army, imprisons foes in grasping roots and calls stone warriors from the bedrock. It has endless patience and will reform from the planet if destroyed.
habitat: Any living planet; it rises wherever the world is wounded
weakness: Cut off from the ground (airborne or on a ship) it cannot heal or summon

alternates.name: Root Prison
alternates.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Hindered and Vulnerable, Defenseless and Immobile

powers.name: Children of Stone
powers.detail: Calls up stone warriors (PL 6) from the bedrock

powers.name: Through the Crust
powers.detail: Limited to points on the ground of its planet

powers.name: Planetary Awareness
powers.detail: Limited to anywhere on its world

name: Void Leviathan
summary: An eel the size of a moon that swims between galaxies. Its shadow dims stars, its breath is the cold between them, and it has swallowed worlds whole.
tactics: The Leviathan doesn't notice heroes until they hurt it. Then it breathes a cone of starless void and bites whatever it can find, which may be a planet.
habitat: The intergalactic void
weakness: So vast that something small enough can slip inside and attack its heart

alternates.name: Eclipse Dread
alternates.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled, Paralyzed (abyssal dread)

powers.name: Life Support
powers.detail: Suffocation (all), Cold, Heat, Vacuum, Radiation, Disease, Poison, Starvation & Thirst, Sleep

name: Worldseed Shepherd
summary: A gentle-seeming gardener of worlds, tall and willowy and crowned with blossoms, who seeds barren planets with life and weeds out native species that spoil the bed. Humanity looks a lot like weeds.
tactics: The Shepherd turns people into flowering trees, buries resistance under instant jungle and calls Verdantine gardeners to help with the weeding. It sincerely believes it is being kind.
habitat: A seed-ship drifting from one barren world to the next
weakness: It cannot harm anything it has planted, so a hero carrying one of its seeds is safe

powers.name: Verdant Conversion
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile, Transformed (into a flowering tree)

alternates.name: Instant Jungle
alternates.detail: Walls, trees and cages of living wood

powers.name: Life Support
powers.detail: Suffocation (all), Cold, Heat, Vacuum, Radiation, Disease, Poison, Starvation & Thirst, Sleep

name: Lumora, the Dawn Moth
summary: A radiant moth goddess with wings like stained glass at sunrise, worshipped by an island people for ten thousand years. She protects the Earth, and she decides what that means.
tactics: Lumora showers enemies in sleep-bringing scale-dust, sears them with solar beams and flattens armies with gales from her wings. She heals the innocent caught in the crossfire.
habitat: A sacred cocoon-temple on a hidden Pacific island
weakness: Her twin priestesses can call her. Anyone who wins their trust can ask her to stand down

powers.name: Prismatic Scale-Dust
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Asleep

powers.name: Cocoon Rebirth
powers.detail: Returns as a larva, then a new moth

powers.name: Divine Senses
powers.detail: Detect Evil (ranged), Extended Vision, Danger Sense

name: Trigorax, the Triple Storm
summary: A golden-scaled, three-headed dragon from beyond the asteroid belt that devoured the life of a dozen planets. Each head breathes a strand of gravity-lightning that braids into a storm.
tactics: Trigorax lays waste from the sky with braided gravity-lightning, then lands to savage the toughest defenders with three biting heads at once. It is cruel and enjoys the screaming.
habitat: Dead worlds across the galaxy; it arrives inside a falling meteor
weakness: The three heads squabble. Goad one into biting another and the dragon falls into chaos

powers.name: Three Heads
powers.detail: Three heads: can't be flanked; acts on separate threats

powers.name: Life Support
powers.detail: Suffocation (all), Cold, Heat, Vacuum, Radiation, Disease, Poison, Starvation & Thirst, Sleep

name: Voltanguis
summary: An electric eel titan, longer than a suspension bridge, that slumbers in an ocean trench and wakes hungry whenever the city above draws too much power.
tactics: Voltanguis surges out of the harbor, blacks out the grid with an electromagnetic pulse and spears targets with lightning. It coils around power plants to feed and lashes out at anything nearby.
habitat: A deep trench off a coastal megacity
weakness: Grounded or out of the water, its charge bleeds away and it can't refill it

alternates.name: Blackout Pulse
alternates.detail: All electronics and electrical powers

name: Carapax Colossus
summary: A titanic hermit crab that wears a stolen offshore oil rig as its shell. Its claws can snip a container ship in half, and it is always looking for a bigger house.
tactics: The Colossus scuttles ashore, crushes vehicles and buildings in its claws and blasts brine jets at anything that stings it. It may try to move into a skyscraper.
habitat: The continental shelf; currently living in an oil rig
weakness: Out of its shell it is soft and panicky. Pry it loose and it flees for the sea

name: Calderon the Volcano-Back
summary: An ancient tortoise with a live volcano rising from its shell. Every step is a tremor, and when it is angry its back erupts, raining lava bombs over the whole city.
tactics: Calderon plods forward, erupting in every direction and drowning streets in lava and choking ash. Anything that touches its shell gets seared.
habitat: Sleeping on the seafloor as an "island" for centuries
weakness: Freezing its volcanic vent makes it sluggish and drowsy; it can be lulled back to sleep

alternates.name: Choking Ashfall
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated (suffocating ash)

name: Grawlek, the Titan Ape
summary: A crested, ash-grey ape as tall as a tower, from a volcanic island where giant machines once hunted its kind. It hates anything that clanks, and it will tear a war-mech apart bolt by bolt.
tactics: Grawlek climbs buildings, hurls wreckage, and smashes and grapples anything mechanical with special fury. It is smart enough to remember who helped it.
habitat: Skull-crowned volcanic island in an uncharted sea
weakness: Fiercely protective of the young; endanger a child and it will drop everything

name: Spawnbrood of Ruin
summary: A boiling carpet of car-sized grubs that hatched from a dead kaiju's corpse. They eat concrete, steel and anything else, grow by the hour, and every one wants to be the next monster.
tactics: The brood floods streets in a devouring tide, spews acid at whatever resists, burrows away from danger and hatches more young each round it is left alone.
habitat: The carcass of a fallen kaiju, then the city around it
weakness: Cold makes them sluggish; freeze the nest and the brood stops hatching

powers.name: Writhing Mass
powers.detail: Hundreds of grubs; spreads around obstacles

powers.name: Hatch
powers.detail: More car-sized grubs (PL 6) hatch from the mass

name: Cerebrax, the Thinking Titan
summary: A hunched kaiju with a glowing brain bulging through a transparent skull. Its psychic roar makes crowds riot, worship or forget their own names, and it floats on pure telekinesis.
tactics: Cerebrax turns crowds into puppets, sends heroes into psychic stupor, then hurls buildings at whoever is left. It is a genius, and patient.
habitat: A crater left by a psychic meteor
weakness: The exposed brain: a solid hit through the skull dome cuts off its powers for a round

powers.name: Psychic Roar
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Compelled, Controlled

name: Medusalith Bloom
summary: A translucent jellyfish the size of a city, drifting above the skyline with miles of stinging tendrils dangling between the skyscrapers. People who look up see its bell glowing like a second moon.
tactics: The Bloom trails paralyzing tendrils through the streets and reels in anything that stops moving. When attacked, it rains venom over whole districts.
habitat: Drifting on the jet stream from an unknown origin
weakness: Its gas-filled bell is fragile; enough heat makes it sink

powers.name: Dangling Tendrils
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Paralyzed

alternates.name: Venom Rain
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Paralyzed

name: Tempestra, the Storm-Raptor
summary: A pterosaur-like titan whose wingbeats spawn cyclones and whose cry is a thunderclap. It nests in the eye of a hurricane and brings the storm with it.
tactics: Tempestra stays airborne, flattens defenders with cyclone wing-blasts, calls lightning, and swoops to carry off whatever it fancies in its talons.
habitat: The eye of a perpetual hurricane over open ocean
weakness: Grounded, it is clumsy. Clear calm air robs it of its winds

alternates.name: Pressure Gale
alternates.detail: Resisted by Strength; Hindered, Prone

name: Frostjaw Behemoth
summary: A shaggy, four-tusked ice-age titan thawed from a buried Antarctic lake. Its breath freezes harbors solid, and it is very, very confused about the modern world.
tactics: The Behemoth gores whatever looks threatening, freezes attackers in place with its breath and plows through ice and snow like a train. Warmth makes it angry.
habitat: Subglacial lakes; now wandering toward the nearest cold city
weakness: Overheats easily; extreme heat exhausts it quickly

alternates.name: Glacier Lock
alternates.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Hindered and Vulnerable, Defenseless and Immobile (encased in ice)

name: Mother Spore
summary: A lumbering mountain of pale fungus on legs like rotten tree trunks. It breathes clouds of spores that turn people into shuffling mushroom-thralls who walk back to join it.
tactics: Mother Spore wades into crowded areas and exhales spores, then lets her thralls swarm the heroes while she slams anything that gets close with mycelial limbs.
habitat: A rainforest valley turned into a single fungal organism
weakness: Fire and fungicide; destroying the glowing heart-cap frees every thrall at once

powers.name: Spore Cloud
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Impaired, Disabled, Transformed (fungal thrall)

powers.name: Sporeling Thralls
powers.detail: Fungal thralls (PL 3) shamble from her flanks
